strongs_1890.strongs_def: to dock off, i.e. curtail (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative); especially to harvest (grass or grain)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: [idiom] at all, cut down, much discouraged, grieve, harvestman, lothe, mourn, reap(-er), (be, wax) short(-en, -er), straiten, trouble, vex.
